title: House of Cards
description: Times Square at night, one coloured point for every pair of pixels, each one placed at its own depth. At rest it is just the photograph. Drag and it comes apart into hard dots of light on black, then thins to the scan rings a spinning lidar would have returned, while the camera swings up to half a radian round the street: the near figure and taxis shear away from the far signs and black shadows open behind them, so the picture shows it was three-dimensional all along. Let go and it settles back into the exact photograph, near points first and the far street last, like a focus pull.
intent: After Radiohead's House of Cards video (James Frost, 2008, shot with Velodyne lidar and no cameras), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/House_of_Cards_(Radiohead_song), and the point clouds of Luma AI captures as they load, https://lumalabs.ai: the world as a drifting cloud of points that holds together as a street, then comes apart.
sources: Photograph: herb, Times Square. Depth: Depth Anything V2 (small).
